top_signals.title: Fed’s Collins Says Holding Rates Hangs on Inflation Progress
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said she supported holding interest steady for now, but conditioned that on seeing more progress in bringing inflation back toward the central bank’s 2% target.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Firms in Japan seek new hedges, bracing for long era of yen weakness
top_signals.summary: The yen is far and away the worst-performing G10 currency, having lost more than 30% against the dollar over the past five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
top_signals.summary: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan continues work to end drunken driving 20 years after tragedy
top_signals.summary: A drunken driving incident in Fukuoka Prefecture that killed three children in 2006 became a turning point for the prefecture and the government to impose stricter regulations.
